content.text: If you sell ebooks and live in Zimbabwe, Nigeria, Venezuela, or other countries where Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad are restricted, you're forced to choose between losing money to 10% platform fees or abandoning your customers to the uncertainty of cash payments. NOWPayments, a low-fee cryptocurrency payment gateway, and COREMERCH, a sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-3|The Full]] company, have partnered to bring you a reliable, fee-efficient way to sell ebooks using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-bitcoin-payments-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-explained-digital|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-downloads-keeps-failing-stack|bitcoin]].

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-first-principles-definitive. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms like Gumroad charge 10% on every sale, leaving you with just 90% of your hard-earned money. NOWPayments, on the other hand, charges a mere 0.5%, retaining you up to 18.9% more of your revenue. This fee difference can add up to $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product. By deploying the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can break free from these exploitative fees and keep the money you've earned.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying the Sovereign Starter Stack, you'll need a GitHub account, a NOWPayments account, and the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide. You'll also need to connect your NOWPayments account to your GitHub repository. This will enable you to accept Bitcoin payments from your customers and automate the delivery of your ebooks.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can set up a payment and delivery pipeline that automatically converts Bitcoin payments to USD at transaction time, allowing you to price your ebooks in a stable currency. This means you can focus on creating great content while COREMERCH handles the infrastructure, ensuring that your ebooks are delivered to your customers instantly and securely.
You can retain up to 18.9% more of your revenue by using NOWPayments instead of platforms like Gumroad.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once you've got your infrastructure up and running, you can scale your ebook sales by adding more products to your catalog, increasing your prices, or targeting new markets. With the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can easily add new products and update your pricing without worrying about complex infrastructure changes. This means you can focus on growing your business while COREMERCH handles the underlying infrastructure.

Will I still make money even if my ebook sales are low? Yes, you will still retain up to 18.9% more of your revenue compared to using platforms like Gumroad, which charge 10% on every sale. This means you can keep more of your hard-earned money, even on low sales days.
With the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can automate the delivery of your ebooks and focus on creating great content.

If you're looking for more information on how to set up a cryptocurrency payment gateway, check out The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), which provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack, follow these steps: purchase the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), create a GitHub account and connect your NOWPayments account to your GitHub repository, deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack, configure your ebook delivery settings, and test your payment and delivery pipeline. Once you've completed these steps, you can start selling your ebooks and receiving payments in Bitcoin.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack?

It typically takes around 48 hours to deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack, depending on your GitHub account settings and the complexity of your ebook delivery settings. Once deployed, you can start selling your ebooks and receiving payments in Bitcoin.
What happens if my ebook sales are low?

Even with low ebook sales, you'll still retain up to 18.9% more of your revenue compared to using platforms like Gumroad, which charge 10% on every sale. This means you can keep more of your hard-earned money, even on low sales days.
Can I use other cryptocurrencies besides Bitcoin?

Yes, NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and many others. You can choose the cryptocurrency that best suits your needs and integrate it into your payment and delivery pipeline.
How do I track my ebook sales and earnings?

You can track your ebook sales and earnings through your NOWPayments dashboard, which provides real-time updates on your sales, earnings, and customer activity. This means you can stay on top of your business and make data-driven decisions to grow your sales.
What if I need help deploying the Sovereign Starter Stack?

COREMERCH provides 30-day support for the Sovereign Starter Stack, which includes guidance on deployment, setup, and troubleshooting. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions.
